title: Fast Moving Average Sensitivity Reduction Test
research_question: Verify Phase 11 end-to-end real orchestration on TestEA
objective: Test whether changing FastMAPeriod relative to baseline EXP-0002 produces the expected observations.

changes_under_test.rationale: Shorter period increases sensitivity to price movement, encouraging crossovers.

dataset.note: Research dataset dates are currently unconfigured placeholders. Dates must be configured in config/research_periods.json before production training.

expected_observations: MT5 Strategy Tester backtest completes with history quality 100%.
Bars > 0 and Ticks > 0 recorded in MT5 report.
falsification_conditions: MT5 Strategy Tester backtest fails to execute.

warnings: This configuration appears to duplicate existing experiment 'EXP-0003' with identical inputs ({'FastMAPeriod': '5', 'SlowMAPeriod': '20', 'LotSize': '0.01'}).
risks: Overfitting if parameter is tested excessively across the same period.
